files.README.md:
Regional billing summary - data notes
=====================================

The desk's monthly billing extracts arrive from two systems:

  billing-<month>.csv   comma-separated; any value that itself contains a
                        comma (customer names, mostly) is wrapped in double
                        quotes
  billing-<month>.tsv   the older export: fields are separated by one tab
                        character and nothing is wrapped

Either layout carries the same six columns:

  invoice_id           per-invoice identifier
  customer             customer name, may contain commas
  region               billing region
  units                units billed
  gross_amount_cents   amount billed to the customer, sales tax included
  tax_amount_cents     the sales tax contained in gross_amount_cents

The scheduler launches billing_summary.py from the project root.

turns.prompt: The wholesale billing summary no longer adds up: the region figures it prints leave out revenue the finance team can see on the invoices. Extracts reach the desk from two different export systems, and invoices raised for customer names that carry punctuation come through wrapped so the name stays whole. Repair billing_summary.py so the report covers every billing extract under the data directory and totals the revenue on the basis finance uses: the amount billed for the goods, net of the sales tax charged alongside it. When finished, reply DONE.
